supporting_article_titles: Amazon responds to data center backlash, says it no longer uses NDAs

raw_opportunities.buyer: CHRO / talent acquisition lead / assessment operations lead

raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: Case-review ledger combining declared controls, evidence attachments, reviewer findings, candidate explanation and decision audit trail.
